name: Barbell Squat
steps: Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and hold the bar across your upper back.
Bend your knees and hips to lower your body while keeping your back straight.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Push through your feet to return to the starting position.

name: Leg Press
steps: Sit on the machine and place your feet shoulder-width apart on the platform.
Release the safety handles and lower the platform by bending your knees.
Stop before your lower back lifts from the seat.
Push through your feet to extend your legs without locking your knees.

name: Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand upright while holding a barbell in front of your thighs.
Keep a slight bend in your knees and push your hips backward.
Lower the bar along your legs while keeping your back straight.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing.

name: Walking Lunge
steps: Stand upright with a dumbbell in each hand.
Take a step forward and lower your body until both knees are bent.
Keep your front knee aligned with your foot.
Push through your front foot and step forward with the other leg.

name: Leg Extension
steps: Sit on the machine and place your lower legs behind the padded bar.
Hold the handles and keep your back against the seat.
Extend your legs until they are nearly straight.
Lower the padded bar slowly to the starting position.
